title: verify_fixes
description: Per-prior-bot-thread judgments of whether the new diff addresses each finding. Mirrors review.json's wrapper-object shape so artifacts read symmetrically across stages.

thread_id.description: VCS thread id (string form of the numeric id, or GraphQL node id).

addressed.description: True iff the new diff resolves the concern.

reason.description: 1–2 sentences max. Cite line(s) or change when addressed=true; why the concern still stands when addressed=false. No essays, no quoting whole hunks.
